Name: Juggernaut
FlavourText: What divides the conqueror \r\n from the conquered? Perseverance.
FlavourText (French): Une seule chose sépare le conquérant \r\ndu conquis : la persévérance.
FlavourText (German): Was unterscheidet den Sieger\r\nvom Besiegten? Seine Beharrlichkeit.
FlavourText (Japanese): 征服する者とされる者を分けるもの。\r\nそれは忍耐だ。
FlavourText (Korean): 정복자와 정복당한 자를 구분 짓는 것은 \r\n 무엇인가? 근성의 차이다.
FlavourText (Portuguese): O que separa o conquistador\r\ndo conquistado? Perseverança.
FlavourText (Thai): <size:53>{         อะไรที่แบ่งแยกผู้พิชิตจากผู้ถูกพิชิตงั้นหรือ? \r\nความมุ่งมั่นไงล่ะ}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): <size:51>{    統治者與被統治者間有什麼區別？\r\n毅力。}
LeagueName (Japanese): アンセストラルコマンダー
LeagueFlavourText (French): Telles furent les paroles de Kahutoroa.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): カフトロアはそう言った。
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:53>{         คาฮูทูรัวตรัสไว้}

Name: Berserker
FlavourText: The savage path is \r\nalways swift and sure.
FlavourText (French): <size:50>{La voie brutale reste \r\nla plus directe \net la plus sûre.}
FlavourText (German): Der Pfad des Wilden \r\nist immer rasant und\r\nbestimmt.
FlavourText (Japanese): 獰猛の道は常に\r\n迅速かつ確実である。\r\n
FlavourText (Portuguese): <size:50>{O caminho selvagem é\r\nsempre rápido e seguro.}
FlavourText (Spanish): <size:45>{El camino salvaje siempre\r\nes rápido y seguro.}
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ทางของความป่าเถื่อน\r\nย่อมว่องไวและแน่นอน}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): <size:55>{通往殘暴的道路\r\n總是快速且\n無法回頭。}
LeagueFlavourText: Ramping does not\r\nmean to run\r\naway in fear.
LeagueFlavourText (French): Accroître sa puissance,\r\nce n'est pas\r\ns'enfuir en courant.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Stampfen bedeutet nicht,\r\ndass man\r\nvor Angst wegläuft.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 向上とは恐れて逃げることではない。
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{การอาละวาด\r\nหาใช่การวิ่งหัวซุกหัวซุน}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 恫嚇指的\r\n不是心懷\r\n恐懼逃跑。

Name: Chieftain
FlavourText: The Ancestors speak \r\nthrough your clenched fists.
FlavourText (French): Les Ancêtres parlent \r\nà travers vos poings.
FlavourText (German): Die Ahnen sprechen \r\ndurch Eure geballten Fäuste.
FlavourText (Japanese): 先祖達は握った拳を通して\r\n語りかけてくる。
FlavourText (Korean): 선조들께서 그대의 떨리는 \r\n주먹을 통해 말하고 \r\n있지 않은가.
FlavourText (Portuguese): Os Ancestrais falam\r\natravés dos seus punhos cerrados.
FlavourText (Spanish): Los ancestros hablan \r\na través de tus\npuños cerrados.
FlavourText (Thai): <size:60>{   บรรพบุรุษเอ่ย\r\nผ่านหมัดที่กำแน่นของเจ้า}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 祖靈透過\r\n你緊握的雙拳發言。
LeagueFlavourText: History must be preserved \r\nnot just of our ancestors.
LeagueFlavourText (French): L'histoire doit être préservée,\r\nmais pas seulement celle de nos ancêtres.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Die Geschichte muss bewahrt werden,\r\nnicht nur die unserer Vorfahren.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 歴史に残すべきは先祖たちだけではない。
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): A história deve ser preservada,  \r\nnão apenas a de nossos ancestrais.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Необходимо сохранять \r\nисторию не только наших предков.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): Toda la historia debe preservarse, \r\nno solo la de nuestros ancestros.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:60>{   ประวัติศาสตร์ต้องรักษาไว้\r\nหาใช่เพียงประวัติศาสตร์บรรพชนเราเท่านั้น}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): ……歷史必須有人來守護，\r\n不只是我們祖先的歷史。

Name: Warden
FlavourText: A sacred duty. An ancestral promise.\r\nDeliver the fury of the wilds and\r\ntear evil asunder.
FlavourText (French): Un devoir sacré. Une promesse ancestrale.\r\nDéchaînez la fureur de la nature et\r\nmettez le mal en pièces.
FlavourText (German): Eine heilige Pflicht. Ein uraltes Versprechen.\r\nEntfesselt die Gewalt der Wildnis und\r\nreißt das Böse in Stücke.
FlavourText (Japanese): 神聖な義務。古の誓い。\r\n自然の怒りの代行者となり\r\n邪悪を引き裂け。
FlavourText (Korean): 성스러운 의무. 선대의 약속.\r\n야생의 분노를 내뿜어\r\n악을 산산조각 내라.
FlavourText (Portuguese): Um dever sagrado. Uma promessa ancestral. Parta o mal ao meio com a fúria selvagem.
FlavourText (Russian): Священный долг. Обещание предков.\r\nНеси ярость диких лесов и\r\nрви зло на части.
FlavourText (Spanish): Un deber sagrado. Una promesa ancestral.\r\nDesata la furia de la naturaleza y\r\naniquila el mal.
FlavourText (Thai): <size:60>{หน้าที่ศักดิ์สิทธิ์ สัญญาแห่งบรรพชน \r\nนำโทสะแห่งสายลมไปฉีกทึ้ง\r\nความชั่วช้าให้สิ้นซาก}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 神聖的職責。先祖的承諾。\r\n釋放野性的憤怒\r\n並將邪惡撕裂。
LeagueFlavourText: The First Ones exist,\r\nI have seen them in the\r\nforest of the night.
LeagueFlavourText (French): Les Premiers existent,\r\nJe les ai vus dans la\r\nforêt de la nuit.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Die Ersten existieren,\r\nich habe sie in den\r\nWäldern der Nacht gesehen.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 最初のものたちは存在する。私は夜の森で彼らを見たことがある。
LeagueFlavourText (Korean): 최초의 존재들은 존재하노니,\r\n내가 밤의 숲에서\r\n그들을 보았노라.
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): Os Primeiros Seres existem,  \r\neu os vi na floresta da noite.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Первые существуют, \r\nя видела их \r\nв ночном лесу.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): Los Primeros existen,\r\nlos he visto en\r\nel bosque de la noche.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:60>{ทวยเทพผู้บุกเบิกมีจริง\r\nข้ามองเห็นพวกท่าน\r\nในป่าเขายามค่ำคืน}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 初始之靈猶存，\r\n我曾在夜晚的森林中\r\n親眼見過祂們。

Name: Deadeye
FlavourText: A woman can change the world \r\nwith a single well-placed arrow.
FlavourText (French): Une femme peut changer le monde\r\n     d'une seule flèche bien placée.
FlavourText (German): Eine Frau kann die Welt mit\r\neinem gezielten Schuss verändern.
FlavourText (Japanese): 一本の狙い澄ました矢で\r\n彼女は世界を変えることができる。
FlavourText (Korean): 잘 조준한 화살 한 발이면 \r\n여성도 세상을 바꿀 수 있다.
FlavourText (Portuguese): Uma mulher pode mudar o mundo\r\ncom uma única flecha bem atirada.
FlavourText (Russian): Женщина может изменить мир \r\nодним метким выстрелом.
FlavourText (Spanish): Una mujer puede cambiar el mundo\r\ncon una simple flecha certera.
FlavourText (Thai): ผู้หญิงคนหนึ่งสามารถเปลี่ยนโลก\r\nได้ด้วยศรแม่นยำเพียงดอกเดียว
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 一支精準的箭矢，\r\n即可改變世界的女人。
LeagueFlavourText: it all feels wrong\r\nno I don't belong here
LeagueFlavourText (French): Tout cela semble faux\r\nnon, je n'ai pas ma place ici.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Es fühlt sich alles falsch an.\r\nNein, ich gehöre nicht hierher.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): おかしい\r\nわたしはここにいるべきではない
LeagueFlavourText (Korean): 다 잘못됐어\r\n여기는 내가 있을 곳이 아냐
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): Está tudo errado,  \r\nnão, eu não pertenço a este lugar.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): все это неправильно\r\nнет, мне здесь не место
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): siento que está todo mal\r\nno pertenezco aquí
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): ช่างผิดแผกแปลกประหลาดนัก\r\nข้าไม่ควรอยู่ที่นี่
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 這感覺完全不對\r\n不，我不屬於這裡

Name: Pathfinder
FlavourText: There are venoms and virtues aplenty in \r\n the wilds, if you know where to look.
FlavourText (French): La nature regorge de poisons et de baumes\r\n              pour qui sait où les trouver.
FlavourText (German): Mit geübtem Blick entdeckt Ihr \r\n  eine Vielzahl an Giften und Kräutern\r\n  in der Wildnis.
FlavourText (Japanese): どこを探せばいいかわかっていれば、\r\n自然は毒と薬で溢れている。
FlavourText (Korean): <size:55>{위치만 확실히 파악한다면,\r\n극약이나 이익이 되는\r\n   야생의 재료들은 즐비하다.}
FlavourText (Portuguese): Venenos e virtudes existem em abundância\r\n na natureza, se você souber onde procurar.
FlavourText (Russian): В глуши много опасных и желанных мест. \r\nНадо уметь обходить одни и \r\nнаходить другие.
FlavourText (Spanish): Existen venenos y virtudes en abundancia\r\nen la naturaleza, si sabes dónde buscar.
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ในป่ามีทั้งพิษร้ายและประโยชน์มากมาย\r\nหากเจ้ารู้ว่ามันอยู่หนใด}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 荒野中充滿了惡毒與美善，\r\n只要你知道在何處尋找。
LeagueFlavourText: Once the Wildwood is purified\r\nnature will bloom again.
LeagueFlavourText (French): Une fois la Sylve purifiée,\r\nla nature fleurira à nouveau.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Sobald der Finsterwald gereinigt ist,\r\nwird die Natur wieder erblühen.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): ワイルドウッドが浄化されれば再び自然は芽吹く。
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): Uma vez que a Selva for purificada,  \r\na natureza florescerá novamente.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Как только Диколесье очистится, \r\nприрода снова расцветет.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): Cuando purifiquemos el Bosque viridino\r\nla naturaleza volverá a florecer.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{เมื่อป่าวิเศษกลับมาบริสุทธิ์ไซร้\r\nธรรมชาติจักเบ่งบาน}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 待到荒林完成淨化之時，\r\n自然必將再度繁衍盛放。

Name: Occultist
FlavourText: Throw off the chains\r\nof fear and embrace that\r\n which was forbidden.
FlavourText (French): Libérez-vous des \r\nchaînes de la peur pour \r\n  étreindre l'interdit.
FlavourText (German): <size:45>{Löst Euch von den Ketten \r\nEurer Angst und gebt Euch \r\ndem Verbotenen hin.}
FlavourText (Japanese): 恐怖の鎖を解き放ち、\r\n禁じられしものを受け入れよ。
FlavourText (Portuguese): Jogue fora as correntes\r\ndo medo e abrace aquilo\r\nque era proibido.
FlavourText (Russian): Если сбросить оковы \r\nстраха, можно вкусить \r\nзапретный плод.
FlavourText (Spanish): <size:43>{  Deshazte de las cadenas \r\ndel miedo y abraza aquello que\r\nestaba prohibido.}
FlavourText (Thai): <size:58>{ทิ้งโซ่ตรวนแห่งความกลัวแล้ว\r\nน้อมรับสิ่งต้องห้าม}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 拋開恐懼的枷鎖，\r\n擁抱禁忌的秘術。

Name: Elementalist
FlavourText: Feed a storm with savage intent \r\nand not even the strongest walls\r\nwill hold it back.
FlavourText (French): Nourrissez une tempête de vos plus \r\nfarouches desseins, et nul rempart \r\nne saura y résister.
FlavourText (German): Nährt den Sturm mit wilder Entschlossenheit \r\nund selbst die stärksten Gemäuer werden\r\nunter ihm nachgeben.
FlavourText (Japanese): 嵐に凶暴な意思を与えれば、\r\n最強の壁すら抑えることは出来ない。
FlavourText (Korean): 포악한 의지로 폭풍을 일으켜라\r\n그 어떤 강력한 벽일지라도\r\n무너지리니.
FlavourText (Portuguese): Alimente a tempestade com intenções selvagens\r\ne nem mesmo as paredes mais fortes \r\nirão segurá-la.
FlavourText (Russian): Если сильный волей посеет ветер, \r\nбурю не сдержат и крепчайшие \r\nстены.
FlavourText (Spanish): Alimenta una tormenta con propósito feroz\r\ny ni siquiera las paredes más fuertes\r\npodrán detenerla.
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{หล่อเลี้ยงพายุด้วยเจตนาอันโหดร้าย\r\nกระทั่งกำแพงอันแสนแกร่ง\r\nก็ไม่อาจต้านทาน}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 將野蠻意向奉獻於風暴中，\r\n最堅固的高牆也將無法抵擋。
LeagueFlavourText: The end of all things is inevitable.\r\nIt is sooner than you think.
LeagueFlavourText (French): La fin de tout est inévitable.\r\nEt celle-ci approche.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Das Ende aller Dinge ist unausweichlich.\r\nEs ist schneller da, als man denkt.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 万物の終焉は避け得ぬことだ。そして其方が考えているよりも近い。
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): O fim de todas as coisas é inevitável.  \r\nEle está mais próximo do que você pensa.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Конец всего неизбежен. \r\nОн наступит раньше, чем ты думаешь.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): El final de todas las cosas es inevitable.\r\nOcurrirá antes de lo que piensas.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{จุดจบของสรรพสิ่งใกล้เข้ามา\r\nใกล้กว่าที่เจ้าคิด}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 萬物的終結無法避免。\r\n那一刻比你想的還要近。

Name: Necromancer
FlavourText: Embrace the serene\r\npower that is undeath.
FlavourText (French): Embrassez la douce \r\npuissance de la non-vie.
FlavourText (German): Macht Euch die\r\ngrenzenlose Macht der\r\nUntoten zu Nutze.
FlavourText (Japanese): 不死という安らかな力を\r\n受け入れよ。
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{น้อมรับพลังอันสงบนิ่ง\r\nที่ไม่มีวันตาย}
LeagueFlavourText (German): Die Einnahme von Gift\r\nstärkt den Charakter.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 毒を飲むのは人格形成に良い。
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ยิ่งดื่มพิษ\r\nยิ่งฤทธิ์แกร่งกล้า}

Name: Slayer
FlavourText: No judge. No jury.\r\nJust the executioner.
FlavourText (French): Ni juge, ni juré ;\r\nseulement le bourreau.
FlavourText (German):
Kein Gerichtsherr. 
Kein Geschworener. 
      Lediglich der 
      Scharfrichter.
FlavourText (Japanese): 判事も陪審員もいない。\r\nいるのは処刑人だけだ。
FlavourText (Korean): 법관도, 배심원도 없다.\r\n오직 처형자만 있을 뿐.
FlavourText (Portuguese): Sem juiz. Sem júri.\r\nApenas o executor.
FlavourText (Spanish): Ni juez. Ni jurado.\r\nSolamente el verdugo.
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ไม่มีผู้พิพากษา\r\nไม่มีคณะลูกขุน \r\nมีเพียงแต่เพชฌฆาต}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): <size:55>{沒有法官，沒有陪審團，\r\n只有劊子手。}
LeagueFlavourText: Stop thinking that\r\nlife is fair.\r\nIt is not.
LeagueFlavourText (French): Arrêtez de penser que\r\nla vie est juste.\r\nElle ne l'est pas.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Hört auf zu glauben,\r\ndass das Leben fair sei.\r\nDas ist es nicht.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 人生が公平だと考えるのをやめよ。公平ではない。
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): Pare de pensar que  \r\na vida é justa.  \r\nEla não é.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Перестань думать, \r\nчто жизнь справедлива. \r\nЭто не так
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): Deja de pensar que\r\nla vida es justa.\r\nNo lo es.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{เลิกคิดเถิด\r\nว่าชีวิตมันยุติธรรม\r\nมันหาได้เป็นเช่นนั้นไม่}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 別再認為\r\n眾生平等了。\r\n沒有這種事。

Name: Gladiator
FlavourText: Raise your hand to the \r\nroaring crowd and pledge \r\nyour allegiance to glory.
FlavourText (French): Levez les bras sous les \r\nacclamations de la foule et \r\nprêtez allégeance à la gloire.
FlavourText (German):
<size:45>{Hebt Euren Arm empor, der
grölenden Menge entgegen
und gelobet Eure Treue dem
Ruhm.}
FlavourText (Japanese): 狂騒の群衆に向けて手を挙げ、\r\n栄光への忠誠を誓え。
FlavourText (Korean): 포효하는 군중들에게 \r\n손을 들어 찬란한 영광 앞에 \r\n충성을 맹세하라.
FlavourText (Portuguese): Levante a mão para a \r\nmultidão e jure\r\nlealdade à glória.
FlavourText (Russian):
Подними руки вверх
под крики толпы и 
поклянись в верности 
славе.
FlavourText (Spanish): <size:50>{Alza tu mano hacia la\r\nmultitud rugiente y promete\r\ntu lealtad a la gloria.}
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ชูมือให้ผู้ชมที่โห่ร้อง \r\nปฏิญาณตนต่อความรุ่งโรจน์}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): <size:55>{在喧嘩的群眾前舉\n起你的手，向榮耀宣誓。}
LeagueFlavourText: Life is more enjoyable when\r\nthe outcome is unexpected.
LeagueFlavourText (French): La vie est plus agréable\r\nlorsque l'issue est inattendue.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Das Leben ist angenehmer,\r\nwenn der Ausgang überraschend ist.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 予期せぬ出来事が起こった時の方が人生というのは楽しいものだ。
LeagueFlavourText (Korean): 결과가 예상을 벗어날 때\r\n삶이 더 즐거운 법.
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): A vida é mais prazerosa quando o resultado é inesperado.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): С каждым неожиданным поворотом \r\nжизнь становится ярче.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): La vida se disfruta más cuando\r\nel resultado es inesperado.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ชีวิตน่าอภิรมย์\r\nยามที่ผลลัพธ์มิอาจคาดคะเน}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 無法預料的結果，\r\n會讓人生變得更精彩。

Name: Champion
FlavourText:
Champion that which 
 you love. He who fights
 for nothing, dies
 for nothing.
FlavourText (French):
Défendez ce qui 
  vous est cher. Celui qui
    se battra sans cause 
       périra pour rien.
FlavourText (German):
<size:55>{Ein wahrer Streiter

kämpft für das, was er

liebt. Wer für nichts lebt,

stirbt für nichts.}
FlavourText (Japanese): 汝の愛するチャンピオン。\r\n彼はただ戦い、ただ死ぬ。
FlavourText (Portuguese):
Proteja aquilo que
ama. Aquele que luta
por nada, morre
por nada.
FlavourText (Russian):
Защищай то, что
любишь. Тот, кому не
за что сражаться, 
умирает впустую.
FlavourText (Spanish):
<size:55>{Sé el campeón de
lo que amas. Quien no
lucha por nada, muere
por nada.}
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{วีรชนที่คุณรัก \r\nผู้ที่ไม่ได้สู้เพื่อสิ่งใด \r\nย่อมตายอย่างไร้ค่า}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 受人愛戴的冠軍，\r\n不為任何而戰，\r\n不為任何而死。
LeagueFlavourText: Faith has taught me it\r\nis righteous to protect\r\nothers ahead of oneself.
LeagueFlavourText (French): La foi m'a appris qu'il\r\nest juste de protéger\r\nles autres avant soi-même.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Der Glaube hat mich gelehrt,\r\ndass es rechtschaffen ist, andere\r\nvor sich selbst zu schützen.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 自身よりも他人を先に守ることが正義だと、信仰に教えられた。
LeagueFlavourText (Korean): 신앙이 내게 가르치길\r\n나보다 남들을 먼저 지키는 것이\r\n정의롭다 하였다.
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): A fé me ensinou que  \r\né justo proteger os outros  \r\nantes de si mesmo.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Вера наставила меня: благородство \r\nпроявляется в том, чтобы оберегать \r\nдругих, пренебрегая собой.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): La fe me ha enseñado que\r\nes justo proteger\r\na otros antes que a mí.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ศรัทธาสอนข้า\r\nว่าการคุ้มครองผู้อื่นก่อนตน\r\nเป็นเรื่องที่ถูกต้อง}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 信仰教會我，\r\n無私地保護他人\r\n乃是正義的舉動。

Name: Inquisitor
FlavourText: Truth is elusive, yet God has\r\nprovided us with all the tools \r\n necessary to find it.
FlavourText (French): <size:52>{  La vérité est certes élusive,\nmais Dieu nous a fourni tous les\noutils nécessaires pour la trouver.}
FlavourText (German):
Die Wahrheit ist trügerisch
und doch gab uns Gott
 sämtliche Werkzeuge, sie zu 
 entlocken.
FlavourText (Japanese): 真実は捉え難いが、\r\n神はそれを見いだすための\r\n道具全てを我々に与えた。
FlavourText (Korean): 진실을 찾는 건 어렵다,\r\n허나 신께선 우리에게 진실을\r\n찾을 모든 도구를 내어주셨다.
FlavourText (Portuguese): A verdade é elusiva, mas Deus\r\nnos forneceu todas ferramentas\r\nnecessárias para encontrá-la.
FlavourText (Russian):
У правды есть привычка 
ускользать, но Бог даровал 
нам все инструменты для 
её поимки.
FlavourText (Spanish): <size:45>{La verdad es esquiva y sin embargo\nDios nos proporcionó todas las\nherramientas necesarias para encontrarla.}
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{แม้สัจธรรมจะยากที่จะหยั่งถึง\r\nพระเจ้าได้มอบเครื่องมือทุกอย่าง\r\nที่จำเป็น เพื่อค้นหาสัจธรรมนั้น}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): <size:45>{即便真理難以捉模，\r\n上帝給了我們所有找尋的工具。}
LeagueFlavourText: The era of Order and its\r\nconsequences have been\r\na disaster for mortals.
LeagueFlavourText (French): L'ère de l'Ordre et ses\r\nconséquences ont été\r\nun désastre pour les mortels.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Die Ära der Ordnung und\r\nihre Folgen waren für die\r\nSterblichen eine Katastrophe.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 秩序とその結果の時代は人類にとって破滅的だった。
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): A era da Ordem e suas  \r\nconsequências foram  \r\num desastre para os mortais.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Эпоха Порядка и ее \r\nпоследствия стали \r\nкатастрофой для смертных.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): La era del orden y sus\r\nconsecuencias han sido\r\nun desastre para los mortales.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ยุคสมัยแห่งออเดอร์\r\nและผลลัพธ์ที่มันก่อเอาไว้\r\nเป็นหายนะแก่มนุษย์นัก}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 教團的時代以及\r\n其帶來的後果，\r\n對凡人來說只是災難。

Name: Hierophant
FlavourText: Drink deeply from God's\r\n chalice, for the faithful\r\n will never find it empty.
FlavourText (French): <size:45>{Buvez à la coupe de Dieu sans\r\nretenue, car elle demeurera \r\ntoujours pleine pour les fidèles.}
FlavourText (German):
Trinket reichlich aus
 dem Kelche Gottes, denn 
 Euer Glaube wird Euch
 niemals dursten lassen.
FlavourText (Japanese): 神の聖杯をあおりたまえ。\r\n信心深い者にとってそれが\r\n底をつくことはないのだから。
FlavourText (Korean): <size:43>{마를 줄 모르는 \r\n신앙을 위하여, \r\n깊이 신의 성배를 들이키노라.}
FlavourText (Portuguese): Beba tudo do cálice\r\nde Deus, pois para os fiéis\r\nele nunca ficará vazio.
FlavourText (Russian):
<size:50>{Из чаши Господней пей 
полными глотками, 
ибо не опустеет она 
в руках истинно верующего.}
FlavourText (Spanish): <size:45>{Bebe a fondo del cáliz de Dios\r\npues los fieles nunca\r\nlo encontrarán vacío.}
FlavourText (Thai): <size:60>{ดื่มด่ำถ้วยทองของพระเจ้า\r\nผู้เปี่ยมศรัทธาย่อมพบว่า\r\nถ้วยนั้นไม่มีวันว่างเปล่า}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 深飲上帝的聖杯，\r\n對忠實的信徒永遠不會乾枯。
LeagueFlavourText (French): Qui a dit que la vie\r\ns'arrête après la mort ?
LeagueFlavourText (German): Wer sagt, dass das Leben\r\nmit dem Tod endet?
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 人生が死で終わると誰が決めた？
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): Quem disse que a vida  \r\ntermina na morte?
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Кто сказал, что жизнь \r\nзаканчивается со смертью?
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): ¿Quién dice que la vida\r\ntermina en la muerte?
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:60>{ใครบอกว่าความตาย\r\nเป็นจุดจบของชีวิตเล่า?}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 誰說死亡是\r\n生命的終結？

Name: Guardian
FlavourText: When bound by faith\r\n and respect, the flock\r\n will overwhelm the wolf.
FlavourText (French): <size:48>{Uni par la foi \r\n et le respect, le troupeau \r\n l'emportera toujours sur le loup.}
FlavourText (German):
Im Glauben und in 
 Zuversicht verbunden wird
 die Herde den Wolf stets
 überwältigen.
FlavourText (Japanese): 信仰と尊敬で結ばれていれば、\r\n羊の群れは狼を圧倒する。
FlavourText (Korean): <size:47>{신앙과 경의로 똘똘 뭉친다면\r\n양 떼 무리일지라도\r\n늑대를 압도할지어다.}
FlavourText (Portuguese): Quando unido pela fé\r\ne respeito, o rebanho\r\nesmaga o lobo.
FlavourText (Spanish): <size:50>{Cuando está unido por la fe\r\ny el respeto, el rebaño\r\nabrumará al lobo.}
FlavourText (Thai): <size:50>{เมื่อยึดมั่นในความเคารพศรัทธา\r\nฝูงสัตว์ย่อมครองชัยเหนือหมาป่า}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 以忠誠和尊敬連結，\r\n連狼群也被制伏的團結。
LeagueFlavourText: Surely one of them\r\nhas the right answers?
LeagueFlavourText (French): L’un d’entre eux doit forcément avoir\r\nles bonnes réponses, n'est-ce pas ?
LeagueFlavourText (German): Sicherlich hat einer von ihnen\r\ndie richtigen Antworten?
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): さすがにせめて一人は正しい答えを持っているだろう？
LeagueFlavourText (Korean): 이 중에 하나라도\r\n정답을 아는 신이 있겠지?
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): Certamente um deles  \r\ntem as respostas certas?
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Наверняка, среди них найдется тот, \r\nкто владеет истинными ответами.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:50>{ต้องมีสักองค์\r\nที่ให้คำตอบถูกต้องได้เป็นแน่?}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 其中一位神祇一定\r\n有正確的答案吧？

Name: Assassin
FlavourText: Death is a banquet. \r\n It's up to the murderer \r\n to write the menu.
FlavourText (French): La mort est un banquet, \r\n et c'est au meurtrier \r\n d'en composer le menu.
FlavourText (German): Der Tod ist ein Festmahl. \r\nDie Gänge wählt allein \r\nder Mörder.
FlavourText (Japanese): 死は祝宴である。\r\nメニューを書くのは殺し屋の役目だ。
FlavourText (Portuguese): Morte é o banquete.\r\nEscrever o menu fica\r\na critério do assassino.
FlavourText (Russian): Смерть — это званый обед, \r\nсписок блюд которого \r\nсоставляет убийца.
FlavourText (Spanish): La muerte es un banquete.\r\nEs el asesino\r\nquien escribe el menú.
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ความตายคืองานเลี้ยง \r\nฆาตกรคือผู้เขียนเมนู}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 死亡是一場盛宴，\r\n由刺殺者寫下菜單。
LeagueFlavourText: The Queen of Spiders\r\npreys upon mortals to\r\nfulfil her dark desires.
LeagueFlavourText (French): La Reine des Araignées\r\nexploite les mortels pour\r\nassouvir ses sombres désirs.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Die Königin der Spinnen\r\nmacht Jagd auf Sterbliche, um\r\nihre dunklen Wünsche zu erfüllen.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 蜘蛛の女王は昏き願望を満たすため定命の者を喰らう。
LeagueFlavourText (Korean): 거미의 여왕은\r\n검은 욕망을 채우려고\r\n필멸자를 먹이로 삼는다.
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): A Rainha das Aranhas  \r\nse alimenta dos mortais para  \r\nsatisfazer seus desejos sombrios.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Королева пауков охотится \r\nна смертных, чтобы исполнить \r\nсвои темные желания.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): La Reina de las arañas\r\nutiliza a los mortales para\r\ncumplir sus oscuros deseos.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ราชินีแมงมุมออกล่ามนุษย์\r\nเพื่อสนองตัณหามืดมนขอเธอ}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 毒蛛之后以\r\n凡人為食，\r\n滿足她黑暗的慾望。

Name: Trickster
FlavourText: Everyone knows how to die. \r\n Some just need a little nudge \r\nto get them started.
FlavourText (French): <size:43>{ Tout le monde sait comment mourir. \r\n Certains ont juste besoin d'un coup de pouce \r\npour y parvenir.}
FlavourText (German):
Jeder weiß, wie man stirbt. 
Einigen fehlt nur der
richtige Anstoß für den 
ersten Schritt dorthin.
FlavourText (Japanese): 誰もが死に方を知っている。\r\nただ、少し後押しが必要な者もいる。
FlavourText (Korean): 다들 어떻게 죽는지는 알고 있잖아, \r\n 근데 어떤 치들은 살짝 휘저어만 주면 \r\n서로 죽이기 시작하더라고.
FlavourText (Portuguese): Todos sabem como morrer.\r\nAlguns apenas precisam de um\r\nempurrão para chegar lá.
FlavourText (Russian): Умереть могут все, \r\nно некоторых надо слегка \r\nк этому подтолкнуть.
FlavourText (Spanish): Todo el mundo sabe cómo morir.\r\nAlgunos solamente necesitan\r\nun pequeño empujón para empezar.
FlavourText (Thai):
<size:53>{

ทุกคนรู้ว่าต้องตายอย่างไร
บางคนต้องอาศัยการผลักดันเพียงเล็กน้อย}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): <size:50>{所有人都知道如何死亡，\r\n只是某些人需要幫忙輕輕推一把。}
LeagueName (Japanese): ブラインドプロフェット
LeagueFlavourText: The sightless look to the\r\ndarkness for nourishment.
LeagueFlavourText (French): Les aveugles se tournent vers\r\nl'obscurité pour leur subsistance.
LeagueFlavourText (German): Die Augenlosen suchen in der\r\nDunkelheit nach Nahrung.
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): 視界無き者は闇に栄養を求める。
LeagueFlavourText (Portuguese): Os sem visão buscam  \r\nna escuridão o sustento.
LeagueFlavourText (Russian): Незрячие смотрят во \r\nтьму в поисках пищи.
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): Los invidentes miran a la\r\noscuridad para sustentarse.
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:53>{ผู้ตาบอดมองหาความมืดมิด\r\nเพื่อหล่อเลี้ยงตน}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 目盲之人在黑暗中\r\n尋求滋養。

Name: Saboteur
FlavourText: The artist need not be present \r\n to make a lasting impression.
FlavourText (French): <size:45>{Nul besoin pour l'artiste d'être présent \r\nsur les lieux pour marquer les esprits.}
FlavourText (German): <size:45>{Für einen bleibenden Eindruck bedarf es\r\nnicht der Anwesenheit des Künstlers.}
FlavourText (Japanese): 強い印象を残すのに\r\n芸術家がそこにいる必要はない。
FlavourText (Korean): 예술가는 모습을 드러내지 않고도\r\n깊은 인상을 심어줄 수 있는 법이지.
FlavourText (Portuguese): <size:50>{O artista não precisa estar presente\r\npara deixar uma impressão duradoura.}
FlavourText (Russian): Истинный художник производит \r\nнеизгладимое впечатление и без \r\nличного присутствия.
FlavourText (Spanish): <size:45>{No es necesario que el artista esté presente\r\npara causar una impresión duradera.}
FlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{ศิลปินไม่จำเป็นต้องปรากฏ\r\nก็สามารถสร้างความประทับใจได้ไม่รู้ลืม}
FlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 不需要藝術家的存在來\r\n留下深遠的印象。
LeagueFlavourText (French): Apprenez à un Exilé à pêcher\r\net <censuré>
LeagueFlavourText (German): Bring einem Verbannten das Fischen bei\r\nund <zensiert>
LeagueFlavourText (Japanese): エグザイルに釣りを教えれば<黒塗り>
LeagueFlavourText (Spanish): Enseña a un exiliado a pescar,\r\ny <censurado>
LeagueFlavourText (Thai): <size:55>{สอนให้เอ็กไซล์ตกปลา\r\nแล้วเขาจะ<เซ็นเซอร์>}
LeagueFlavourText (Traditional Chinese): 教會一名流亡者釣魚，\r\n就能<redacted>
